description: Render one HTTPS URL through a short-lived gstack CDP browser. CS_BROWSER_VISIBILITY defaults to auto: authenticated Google Tasks, X, and LinkedIn partitions use headed installed Google Chrome, while public pages use headless Playwright Chromium. Set CS_BROWSER_VISIBILITY=headless for an authenticated comparison run or CS_BROWSER_VISIBILITY=headed for a visible public diagnostic. Browser state stays outside run/setup trees in separate narrow cookie-import partitions. Saves visible text as canonical evidence and optionally an MHTML archive and link map; archives are omitted for authenticated sessions. Args: {url, archive?, links?}.

links.description: Save a content-addressed JSON map of rendered anchor text and resolved hrefs.
